sanskrit: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave | abhi devām̐ iyakṣate ||
english: Sing to him, O men, to the Pavamāna, to the drop Indu; he seeks to win the gods.

sanskrit: abhi te madhunā payo 'tharvāṇo aśiśrayuḥ | devaṁ devāya devayu ||
english: The Atharvans have blended milk with honey for you; the divine one, god-devoted, for the god.

sanskrit: sa naḥ pavasva śaṁ gave śaṁ janāya śam arvate | śaṁ rājann oṣadhībhyaḥ ||
english: Flow purified for our good, O king — welfare to the cow, welfare to the people, welfare to the steed, welfare to the herbs.

sanskrit: babhrave nu svatavase 'ruṇāya divispṛśe | somāya gātham arcata ||
english: Sing a song to the tawny one, to the self-mighty, to the ruddy one that touches heaven — to Soma.

sanskrit: hastacyutebhir adribhiḥ sutaṁ somam punītana | madhāv ā dhāvatā madhu ||
english: Purify the pressed Soma with the stones shaken in the hands; run the sweet into the sweet.

sanskrit: namased upa sīdata dadhned abhi śrīṇītana | indum indre dadhātana ||
english: Draw near reverently and be seated; press the Soma down and strain it; place the drop in Indra.

sanskrit: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṁ gave | devebhyo anukāmakṛt ||
english: Flow purified, O Soma, slayer of foes, all-seeing, for the welfare of the cow, fulfilling the desires of the gods.

sanskrit: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase | manaścin manasas patiḥ ||
english: For Indra's drinking, for his rapture, you are poured around, O Soma — even the lord of the mind in the mind.

sanskrit: pavamāna suvīryaṁ rayiṁ soma rirīhi naḥ | indav indreṇa no yujā ||
english: O Pavamāna, O Soma, pour upon us riches and heroic strength; O Indu, together with Indra be our companion.

sanskrit: somā asṛgram indavaḥ sutā ṛtasya sādane | indrāya madhumattamāḥ ||
english: The Soma-drops, the Indus, have flowed, pressed out, in the seat of Ṛta — for Indra, most rich in sweetness.

sanskrit: abhi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṁ na mātaraḥ | indraṁ somasya pītaye ||
english: The inspired sages have sung toward him, as cows toward their calf, toward Indra for the drinking of the Soma.

sanskrit: madacyut kṣeti sādane sindhor ūrmā vipaścit | somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ ||
english: The wise one, shaking rapture, dwells in the seat upon the wave of the river; Soma is established upon the Gaurī.

sanskrit: divo nābhā vicakṣaṇo 'vyo vāre mahīyate | somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ ||
english: At the navel of the sky, all-seeing, he is magnified in the fleece of the sheep — Soma who is the wise-willed seer.

sanskrit: yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣv ām̐ antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ | tam induḥ pari ṣasvaje ||
english: The Soma that is placed within the jars, set in the filter — Indu has embraced him all around.

sanskrit: pra vācam indur iṣyati samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi | jinvan kośam madhuścutam ||
english: Indu sends forth the voice above the expanse of the ocean, quickening the honey-dripping vessel.

sanskrit: nityastotro vanaspatir dhīnām antaḥ sabardughaḥ | hinvāno mānuṣā yugā ||
english: The lord of the forest, ever-praised, the fulfiller within the inspired thoughts, urges on the generations of men.

sanskrit: abhi priyā divas padā somo hinvāno arṣati | viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
english: Toward the beloved stations of the sky, Soma the seer flows impelling, with the stream of the inspired one.

sanskrit: ā pavamāna dhāraya rayiṁ sahasravarcasam | asme indo svābhuvam ||
english: O Pavamāna, hold fast for us the wealth of thousandfold splendour; O Indu, that which is self-sprung.

sanskrit: somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradhāro atyaviḥ | vāyor indrasya niṣkṛtam ||
english: Soma flows purified, of a thousand streams, passing through the woolly filter, the appointed share of Vāyu and Indra.

sanskrit: pavamānam avasyavo vipram abhi pra gāyata | suṣvāṇaṁ devavītaye ||
english: Sing forth to the Pavamāna, to the inspired one, you who seek help — to him who is well-pressed for the delight of the gods.

sanskrit: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ | gṛṇānā devavītaye ||
english: The Somas of thousandfold brilliance flow for the winning of prize, being praised for the delight of the gods.

sanskrit: uta no vājasātaye pavasva bṛhatīr iṣaḥ | dyumad indo suvīryam ||
english: And flow for us for the winning of prize, with great refreshments; O Indu, with radiance and heroic strength.

sanskrit: te naḥ sahasriṇaṁ rayim pavantām ā suvīryam | suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||
english: Let those Indus, those gods, well-pressed, flow to us with thousandfold wealth and heroic strength.

sanskrit: atyā hiyānā na hetṛbhir asṛgraṁ vājasātaye | vi vāram avyam āśavaḥ ||
english: Swift ones, driven like racing steeds by drivers, they have flowed for the winning of prize; the swift ones have spread the sheep's wool filter apart.

sanskrit: vāśrā arṣantīndavo 'bhi vatsaṁ na dhenavaḥ | dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ ||
english: The bellowing Indu-drops flow toward him as milch-cows toward their calf; they have made their way to the arms.

sanskrit: juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat | viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
english: O Pavamāna, exhilarating, beloved by Indra, roaring aloud — smite away all enemies.

sanskrit: apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardṛśaḥ | yonāv ṛtasya sīdata ||
english: The Pavamānas, gazing upon the light of heaven, driving off the niggards, take their seat in the womb of Ṛta.

sanskrit: pari prāsiṣyadat kaviḥ sindhor ūrmāv adhi śritaḥ | kāram bibhrat puruspṛham ||
english: The seer has rushed all around, established upon the wave of the river, bearing the prized thing much desired.

sanskrit: girā yadī sabandhavaḥ pañca vrātā apasyavaḥ | pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim ||
english: When the five troops of kindred, working with their hands, adorn the sustainer with their voice.

sanskrit: ād asya śuṣmiṇo rase viśve devā amatsata | yadī gobhir vasāyate ||
english: Then all the gods have rejoiced in the juice of this vigorous one when he is clothed with the milk-streams.

sanskrit: niriṇāno vi dhāvati jahac charyāṇi tānvā | atrā saṁ jighnate yujā ||
english: Cleansing himself, he flows forth, leaving behind the husks with his body; here he meets his mate in union.

sanskrit: naptībhir yo vivasvataḥ śubhro na māmṛje yuvā | gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||
english: He who, young and radiant, has cleansed himself among the daughters of Vivasvat, making the cows as a shining garment.

sanskrit: ati śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigāty aṇvyā | vagnum iyarti yaṁ vide ||
english: Passing over the two pressing-boards, going through obliquely, he goes with the slender stream for the cow-pastures; he raises the voice that is known.

sanskrit: abhi kṣipaḥ sam agmata marjayantīr iṣas patim | pṛṣṭhā gṛbhṇata vājinaḥ ||
english: The fingers have come together, purifying the lord of refreshment; they grasp the back of the swift racer.

sanskrit: pari divyāni marmṛśad viśvāni soma pārthivā | vasūni yāhy asmayuḥ ||
english: Touching all the heavenly and earthly things, O Soma, come toward us bearing goods.

sanskrit: eṣa dhiyā yāty aṇvyā śūro rathebhir āśubhiḥ | gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam ||
english: This hero goes by the slender stream of inspiration, with swift chariots, going to the appointed share of Indra.

sanskrit: eṣa purū dhiyāyate bṛhate devatātaye | yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||
english: This one is much meditated upon for the great gathering of the gods, where the immortals are seated.

sanskrit: eṣa hito vi nīyate 'ntaḥ śubhrāvatā pathā | yadī tuñjanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
english: This one, set in motion, is led through the bright path within, when the mighty ones urge him on.

sanskrit: eṣa śṛṅgāṇi dodhuvac chiśīte yūthyo3 vṛṣā | nṛmṇā dadhāna ojasā ||
english: This bull of the herd, shaking his horns, whetted — bearing manly power with might.

sanskrit: eṣa rukmibhir īyate vājī śubhrebhir aṁśubhiḥ | patiḥ sindhūnām bhavan ||
english: This swift racer goes adorned with golden ornaments, with bright stalks, becoming the lord of the rivers.

sanskrit: eṣa vasūni pibdanā paruṣā yayivām̐ ati | ava śādeṣu gacchati ||
english: This one, having gone past the knotty, clinging goods, goes down to the resting places.

sanskrit: etam mṛjanti marjyam upa droṇeṣv āyavaḥ | pracakrāṇam mahīr iṣaḥ ||
english: The descendants of Āyu cleanse this one worthy of cleansing in the troughs, him who sets in motion the great refreshments.

sanskrit: etam u tyaṁ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ | svāyudham madintamam ||
english: And this one the ten fingers cleanse, and the seven devotions — he of his own weapons, most intoxicating.

sanskrit: pra te sotāra oṇyo3 rasam madāya ghṛṣvaye | sargo na takty etaśaḥ ||
english: Your pressers have sent forth the juice for rapturous exhilaration — Etaśa flies like a loosed arrow.

sanskrit: kratvā dakṣasya rathyam apo vasānam andhasā | goṣām aṇveṣu saścima ||
english: By the power of understanding, clothing himself in the waters with the Soma-plant that drives the chariot — we follow in the narrow ways of the cows.

sanskrit: anaptam apsu duṣṭaraṁ somam pavitra ā sṛja | punīhīndrāya pātave ||
english: Release the Soma that is unwet yet hard to pass through into the filter; purify it for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: pra punānasya cetasā somaḥ pavitre arṣati | kratvā sadhastham āsadat ||
english: By the will of the self-purifying one, Soma flows through the filter; by his power he has taken his seat in the common dwelling.

sanskrit: pra tvā namobhir indava indra somā asṛkṣata | mahe bharāya kāriṇaḥ ||
english: The Indus, the Somas, have let you flow, O Indra, with acts of homage — the active ones for great bestowal.

sanskrit: punāno rūpe avyaye viśvā arṣann abhi śriyaḥ | śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||
english: Flowing purified in imperishable form toward all splendours, he stands among the cows like a hero.

sanskrit: divo na sānu pipyuṣī dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ | vṛthā pavitre arṣati ||
english: The stream of the pressed Soma, swollen like the crest of heaven, flows freely through the filter.

sanskrit: tvaṁ soma vipaścitaṁ tanā punāna āyuṣu | avyo vāraṁ vi dhāvasi ||
english: You, O Soma, streaming purified in the lifetimes of the all-wise, run through the fleece of the sheep.

sanskrit: pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vṛtrāṇi bhūrṇayaḥ | somā asṛgram āśavaḥ ||
english: Like rivers rushing downward, smashing obstacles, full-streaming, the swift Somas have flowed forth.

sanskrit: abhi suvānāsa indavo vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīm iva | indraṁ somāso akṣaran ||
english: The pressed Indu-drops, like showers of rain upon the earth, have streamed toward Indra.

sanskrit: atyūrmir matsaro madaḥ somaḥ pavitre arṣati | vighnan rakṣāṁsi devayuḥ ||
english: Soma, intoxicating and exhilarating, of surging waves, flows through the filter, god-seeking, shattering the Rākṣasas.

sanskrit: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pari ṣicyate | ukthair yajñeṣu vardhate ||
english: He runs into the jars, is poured all around through the filter, and grows great among the sacrifices with the lauds.

sanskrit: ati trī soma rocanā rohan na bhrājase divam | iṣṇan sūryaṁ na codayaḥ ||
english: O Soma, passing beyond the three shining realms, you shine as you mount the sky; urging the sun forward, you have set him in motion.

sanskrit: abhi viprā anūṣata mūrdhan yajñasya kāravaḥ | dadhānāś cakṣasi priyam ||
english: The inspired poets, the craftsmen, have sung toward him, the head of the sacrifice, placing the beloved one in the eye.

sanskrit: tam u tvā vājinaṁ naro dhībhir viprā avasyavaḥ ||
english: And you, the swift racer — inspired men, help-seeking, cleanse you with their devotions for the divine gathering.

sanskrit: madhor dhārām anu kṣara tīvraḥ sadhastham āsadaḥ | cārur ṛtāya pītaye ||
english: Flow after the stream of honey; sharp, you have taken your seat in the common place, lovely, to be drunk for Ṛta.

sanskrit: pari suvāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣāḥ | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: Pressed and dwelling on the mountain, Soma has flowed through the filter all around; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: tvaṁ vipras tvaṁ kavir madhu pra jātam andhasaḥ | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: You are the inspired one, you are the seer, the honey born from the Soma plant; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: tava viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītim āśata | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: All the gods, of like enjoyment, have partaken of your drink; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: ā yo viśvāni vāryā vasūni hastayor dadhe | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: You who have placed all desirable goods in your two hands; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: ya ime rodasī mahī sam mātareva dohate | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: You who milk these two great worlds together as a mother; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: pari yo rodasī ubhe sadyo vājebhir arṣati | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: You who flow all around both worlds at once with prizes; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: sa śuṣmī kalaśeṣv ā punāno acikradat | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
english: He, the vigorous one, flowing into the jars self-purified, has cried aloud; in raptures you are the giver of all.

sanskrit: yat soma citram ukthyaṁ divyam pārthivaṁ vasu | tan naḥ punāna ā bhara ||
english: O Soma, whatever brilliant wealth, worthy to be praised in hymns, celestial and earthly, may be — bring that to us as you flow purified.

sanskrit: yuvaṁ hi sthaḥ svarpatī indraś ca soma gopatī | īśānā pipyataṁ dhiyaḥ ||
english: For you two, O Indra and Soma, are lords of the light, lords of the cattle; ruling, do you two swell our inspirations.

sanskrit: vṛṣā punāna āyuṣu stanayann adhi barhiṣi | hariḥ san yonim āsadat ||
english: The bull, flowing purified among the living, thundering upon the sacred grass, being the tawny one, has taken his seat in the womb.

sanskrit: avāvaśanta dhītayo vṛṣabhasyādhi retasi | sūnor vatsasya mātaraḥ ||
english: The devotions have cried out over the seed of the bull — the mothers of the son, of the calf.

sanskrit: kuvid vṛṣaṇyantībhyaḥ punāno garbham ādadhat | yāḥ śukraṁ duhate payaḥ ||
english: Did the purifying one place the embryo in those that desire the bull — those that milk the bright milk?

sanskrit: upa śikṣāpatasthuṣo bhiyasam ā dhehi śatruṣu | pavamāna vidā rayim ||
english: Cast fear upon those who sit plotting against us, upon the enemies; O Pavamāna, find wealth for us.

sanskrit: ni śatroḥ soma vṛṣṇyaṁ ni śuṣmaṁ ni vayas tira | dūre vā sato anti vā ||
english: O Soma, strike down the foe's virile power, strike down his vigour, strike down his strength — whether he is afar or near.

sanskrit: pra kavir devavītaye 'vyo vārebhir arṣati | sāhvān viśvā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
english: The seer flows through the fleece-filters for the delight of the gods, having overcome all rivals.

sanskrit: sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṁ gomantam invati | pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam ||
english: For he indeed impels toward the praisers the thousand-fold prize rich in cattle — the Pavamāna.

sanskrit: pari viśvāni cetasā mṛśase pavase matī | sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ ||
english: You touch all things with your consciousness and flow purified with inspired thought; O Soma, grant us fame.

sanskrit: abhy arṣa bṛhad yaśo maghavadbhyo dhruvaṁ rayim | iṣaṁ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
english: Flow with great glory, with firm wealth for the bountiful ones; bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: tvaṁ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somā viveśitha | punāno vahne adbhuta ||
english: You, O Soma, like a king of righteous vows, have entered the songs; O wondrous carrier, flowing purified.

sanskrit: sa vahnir apsu duṣṭaro mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ | somaś camūṣu sīdati ||
english: He, the carrier, hard to pass in the waters, being cleansed in the hands — Soma takes his seat in the bowls.

sanskrit: krīḻur makho na maṁhayuḥ pavitraṁ soma gacchasi | dadhat stotre suvīryam ||
english: Playful, bountiful like the active Makha, you go to the filter, O Soma, bestowing heroic strength upon the praiser.
